hero.title: When Madurai Comes Alive
hero.description: In Madurai, festivals are not events you simply watch. Streets become stages, temples become living stories, and entire neighbourhoods move together in celebration.

festivalJourney.title: Kodi Yetram
festivalJourney.subtitle: The city receives its invitation
festivalJourney.description: The ceremonial flag hoisting marks the opening of the Chithirai celebrations. From this moment, the temple and surrounding streets begin preparing for days of processions and rituals.

festivalJourney.title: Meenakshi Pattabhishekam
festivalJourney.subtitle: A queen takes her place
festivalJourney.description: Goddess Meenakshi is ceremonially crowned, celebrating her as the powerful queen of Madurai.

festivalJourney.title: Meenakshi Digvijayam
festivalJourney.subtitle: The warrior queen journeys forth
festivalJourney.description: The celebration recalls Meenakshi's victorious journey and presents her in a powerful royal and warrior form.

festivalJourney.title: Meenakshi Thirukalyanam
festivalJourney.subtitle: The celestial wedding
festivalJourney.description: One of the emotional highlights of Chithirai is the sacred wedding of Meenakshi and Sundareswarar, celebrated with elaborate rituals, decorations and processions.

festivalJourney.title: Therottam
festivalJourney.subtitle: When the streets move together
festivalJourney.description: The decorated temple chariot travels through the streets as devotees gather and participate in the traditional procession.

festivalJourney.title: Edhir Sevai
festivalJourney.subtitle: Madurai welcomes Kallazhagar
festivalJourney.description: Kallazhagar's arrival transforms the city into another enormous celebration, with devotees gathering to welcome him.

festivalJourney.title: Kallazhagar & The Vaigai
festivalJourney.subtitle: The moment the whole city waits for
festivalJourney.description: Kallazhagar makes his ceremonial entry into the Vaigai River, creating one of the most spectacular scenes of Madurai's festival calendar.

otherCelebrations.title: Jallikattu
otherCelebrations.description: During Pongal season, the villages around Madurai become arenas of Tamil tradition, courage and pride through Jallikattu.

otherCelebrations.title: Theppa Thiruvizha
otherCelebrations.description: The temple deities are taken in procession to the Mariamman Teppakulam, where the evening becomes a beautiful celebration of water, lamps and devotion.

otherCelebrations.title: Avanimoolam
otherCelebrations.description: The festival brings stories of Shiva's traditional 64 divine plays to life through temple rituals and performances.

otherCelebrations.title: Navarathri
otherCelebrations.description: For nine nights, Meenakshi is celebrated in different forms while the temple glows with lamps and traditional decorations.

experience.title: See
experience.text: Towering gopurams, decorated deities, flower garlands, silk and illuminated streets.

experience.title: Hear
experience.text: Temple bells, traditional instruments, devotional songs and the energy of enormous crowds.

experience.title: Taste
experience.text: Festival food, street snacks and the flavours of a city that loves to eat together.

experience.title: Feel
experience.text: A sense of belonging where visitors, families, devotees and entire neighbourhoods share the same celebration.
